faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Short answers to the questions people ask before starting with SFA.

items.question: What is SFA?
items.answer: SFA is an AI-assisted irrigation optimization system built for arid and semi-arid agriculture.

items.question: How is the irrigation schedule determined?
items.answer: SFA uses crop yield functions and mathematical optimization to determine an optimal schedule for field crops and orchards, then adjusts it for growth stage and water-stress sensitivity.

items.question: How many species does SFA support?
What does the AI assistant do?
items.answer: It takes farming questions in plain language and draws on agricultural databases to provide expert answers and recommendations.

items.question: Which regions is SFA designed for?
items.answer: Arid and semi-arid regions. SFA is compatible with national agricultural datasets and water-management systems.
